services.name: Dive trip
services.desc: Night jumps are one of the five options you have for completing your D-license requirements; but night jumps are not limited just to those pursuing a D. While often accompanied by an increase in adrenaline, night jumps are one of the most beautiful and surreal experiences you can have in the sky. And at Skydive Arizona, we split each night load into two or three passes to limit the number of other canopies sharing that experience with you.Assuming favorable weather, for the night load to fly at least 15 people must be preregistered at Manifest before 3 PM on the day before the night jump.Registration opens one week prior in the Manifest office. You must bring a ticket and cash to the office

You enjoy your afternoons at Copper Sky Recreation Complex, your weekends at Ak-Chin Southern Dunes, family time at Pacana Park, and laid-back evenings around Maricopa’s growing restaurant and entertainment scene. There’s a lot to like about life here: wide-open neighborhoods, desert sunsets, local parks, golf, community events, and that balance between everyday comfort and Arizona adventure.
